name: Supabase
subtitle: Postgres backend-as-a-service
creator: Paul Copplestone and Ant Wilson
description: Each project is a dedicated PostgreSQL database with auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, realtime subscriptions, auth, file storage, edge functions and pgvector. Access control runs in the database through Row Level Security.

languages.written: Elixir, Go, Haskell, TypeScript and C (Postgres)
languages.youWrite: SQL plus a JS/TS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin or Python SDK

concepts.explanation: Every project is a real Postgres database.
Policies decide which rows each user sees.
Listen to database changes over WebSockets.

codeSamples.label: SQL · Row Level Security
JavaScript · query
codeSamples.code:
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('todos')
  .select('id, title, done')
  .eq('done', false)
  .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

pros: It's real Postgres, so SQL and extensions work
cons: RLS policies take care to get right

pricing.summary: Free tier for small projects. Pro from $25/mo. Team from $599/mo. Usage-based overages for compute and storage.
